answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The knoll of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Every claim climbs the tide of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the bridge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
